cards.title: Rating scale, notchChange and notchCalculator (REQ-06-02)
cards.context:
WHY: pure notch calculator (REQ-06-02): previous+current rating -> signed notch change, direction, WL (0-4, higher worse). Other POC modules import exactly these names; card B2 builds on notchChange.
FILES: create src/ratings/notch.mjs and test/ratings/notch.test.mjs (only .gitkeep exist today; remove them only if in the way).
CONTRACT (export exactly these three): (1) RATING_SCALE = Object.freeze(["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]) (19, best first; push throws TypeError in strict ESM). (2) notchChange(previous,current) -> integer index(current)-index(previous); positive downgrade, negative upgrade, 0 unchanged; equal ratings give +0 never -0 (Object.is(result,0)). (3) notchCalculator(previous,current) -> NEW plain object with exactly keys {notches,direction,wl}: notches===notchChange(...) (C5); direction 'downgrade' if >0, 'upgrade' if <0, 'unchanged' if 0; wl (Indicator 13 thresholds per C2/C3/C6, downgrades only): notches<=1 -> 0 (all upgrades, unchanged, 1-notch downgrade), ===2 -> 1, >=3 -> 2. Do NOT export an Indicator 13 function.
VALIDATION: one private non-exported helper (e.g. toIndex). If typeof value !== 'string' throw RangeError (null, undefined, numbers, booleans, {}, ['AAA'], boxed strings; never coerce; never call .trim() before the type check). Then value.trim() (String.prototype.trim), .toUpperCase(), look up in a private Map built from RATING_SCALE (not a plain-object lookup, so 'constructor' cannot match). No match -> RangeError (message names the rejected value; tests assert type only). Inner whitespace 'BBB +', whitespace-only, '', 'BBB++', 'AA\u2212', 'CC','C','D','SD','NR','Baa1','AAA-' are invalid. Missing argument = undefined = RangeError. Both functions validate both args (notchCalculator may call notchChange). B2 relies on notchChange throwing RangeError; keep the helper private. Never return null/undefined/NaN.
CONSTRAINTS: Node 18+ ESM (.mjs); no APIs newer than Node 18; no npm deps; NO imports in this file; no console.*, process.*, node: imports, fetch(, require( in src/. Pure, synchronous, deterministic.
TESTS (node:test + node:assert/strict, TDD): cover AC-1..AC-7 and notch parts of AC-3, AC-11; exhaustive 19x19=361 loop for AC-7 (exact key set, notches===notchChange, valid direction, wl in {0,1,2}); table-driven invalid inputs in first AND second position for both functions with assert.throws(fn, RangeError). Expected values from C1/C2/C3/C5/C6 only. The verbatim POC example ('BBB+ -> BB+ = 2 notch downgrade -> WL=1') is WRONG: never use it in a test or JSDoc as expected; notchCalculator('BBB+','BB+') must be {notches:3,direction:'downgrade',wl:2}. Do not assert message wording.
acceptance: 1. (AC-1) Given `notch.mjs` is imported, when `RATING_SCALE` is read, then it deep-equals `["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]`, `length === 19`, `Array.isArray` is true.

2. (AC-1, X-scale-immutability) Given `RATING_SCALE`, then `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true`; `RATING_SCALE.push("D")` throws `TypeError`; `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` throws `TypeError` (strict ESM); afterwards length is 19 and `RATING_SCALE[0] === "AAA"`.
3. (C2: no Indicator 13 export) Given `import * as ns from ".../notch.mjs"`, `Object.keys(ns).sort()` deep-equals `["RATING_SCALE","notchCalculator","notchChange"]`.
4. (AC-2) `notchChange("BBB+","BB+") === 3`, `notchChange("BBB+","BBB-") === 2`, `notchChange("BBB-","BB+") === 1`.
5. (AC-2) `notchChange("BB+","BBB+") === -3`.
6. (AC-2) `Object.is(notchChange("A","A"), 0) === true` (not `-0`).
7. (AC-2) `notchChange("AAA","CCC-") === 18` and `notchChange("CCC-","AAA") === -18`.

8. (AC-2) For all 361 pairs from `RATING_SCALE`: `Number.isInteger(result)`; `result === RATING_SCALE.indexOf(c) − RATING_SCALE.indexOf(p)`; `notchChange(p,c) === -notchChange(c,p)` (compare with `Object.is`-safe care for zero).
9. (AC-3) `notchChange("bbb+","bb+") === 3`; `notchChange(" BBB+ ","\tbb+\n") === 3`; `notchChange("Aa-","aa-") === 0` (`+0`).
10. (AC-3) `notchCalculator(" bbb+","BBB- ")` deep-strict-equals `{notches:2, direction:"downgrade", wl:1}`.
11. (AC-3, X-trim-semantics) `notchChange(" BBB+ ","bbb") === 1`; `notchChange(" bbb-","BBB-") === 0`.
12. (AC-4, C2) `notchCalculator("BBB+","BB+")` deep-strict-equals `{notches:3, direction:"downgrade", wl:2}`.
13. (AC-4) `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB-")` deep-strict-equals `{notches:2, direction:"downgrade", wl:1}`.
14. (AC-5, C6) `notchCalculator("A","A-")` and `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB")` each deep-strict-equal `{notches:1, direction:"downgrade", wl:0}`.
15. (AC-5) `notchCalculator("A","BBB+")` deep-strict-equals `{notches:2, direction:"downgrade", wl:1}`.
16. (AC-5) `notchCalculator("A","BBB")` -> `{notches:3, direction:"downgrade", wl:2}`; `notchCalculator("AAA","CCC-")` -> `{notches:18, direction:"downgrade", wl:2}`.
17. (AC-6, C3, C5) `notchCalculator("BB+","BBB+")` -> `{notches:-3, direction:"upgrade", wl:0}`; `("BBB","BBB+")` -> `{-1, "upgrade", 0}`; `("CCC-","AAA")` -> `{-18, "upgrade", 0}`.
18. (AC-6) `notchCalculator("A","A")` and `("CCC-","CCC-")` each deep-strict-equal `{notches:0, direction:"unchanged", wl:0}` (deepStrictEqual also catches `-0`).

19. (AC-7, C5) For all 361 pairs, `r = notchCalculator(p,c)`: `Object.keys(r).sort()` deep-equals `["direction","notches","wl"]`; `Object.getPrototypeOf(r) === Object.prototype`; `r.notches === notchChange(p,c)`; direction "downgrade" if notches>0, "upgrade" if <0, "unchanged" if 0; wl 0 if notches
20. (AC-7) Over the 361 pairs: direction counts downgrade 171, upgrade 171, unchanged 19; wl counts 0 = 208, 1 = 17, 2 = 136.

21. (AC-7 / AC-12 deterministic) Two calls `a = notchCalculator("A","BBB")`, `b = notchCalculator("A","BBB")`: `a !== b`; after `a.wl = 99` a third call still deep-strict-equals `{notches:3, direction:"downgrade", wl:2}`.

22. (AC-11, C1) Each invalid value in the Test data list, placed once as `previous` (partner `"BBB"` as current) and once as `current`, for both `notchChange` and `notchCalculator`, throws `RangeError` (`assert.throws(fn, RangeError)`; message not asserted).
23. (AC-11, X-non-string-input) `notchChange()`, `notchChange("AAA")`, `notchCalculator()`, `notchCalculator("AAA")` each throw `RangeError`.

24. (AC-11) `new String("AAA")`, `Symbol("AAA")`, `1n`, `NaN`, `Object.create(null)` in either position throw `RangeError`, never `TypeError` (building the error message must not throw: do not template-interpolate a Symbol or null-prototype object).
25. (AC-11, C1) `"constructor"`, `"__proto__"`, `"toString"`, `"hasOwnProperty"` in either position throw `RangeError`.
26. (AC-11) `notchChange("CC","D")` and `notchCalculator(null, 7)` throw `RangeError`; no partial result, null, undefined or NaN is ever returned.
27. (AC-12 notch part) `grep -nE "^\s*import|import\(" src/ratings/notch.mjs` prints nothing; `grep -rnE "console\.|process\.|from ['\"]node:|fetch\(|require\(" src/ratings/` prints nothing.

28. (AC-12 notch part) `node --input-type=module -e "import {notchChange, notchCalculator} from './src/ratings/notch.mjs'; notchChange('A','BBB'); notchCalculator('BBB+','BB+');"` from the repo root: empty stdout/stderr, exit 0.
29. (AC-13 notch part) `node --test test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` exits 0 with `# fail 0`.

30. (AC-13, C2) No test assertion and no JSDoc presents `("BBB+","BB+")` as `notches:2` or `wl:1`; every hit of `grep -nE "BBB\+['\"]?\s*,\s*['\"]?BB\+|BBB\+\s*(->|→)\s*BB\+" src/ratings test/ratings` shows 3 / wl 2.

cards.title: Indicator 12 country rating change WL (REQ-03-12)
cards.context:
WHY: REQ-03-12 (Indicator 12, country rating change): previous+current country rating -> WL 0, 1 or 2, built on notchChange from B1 (src/ratings/notch.mjs, merged when you start). Other POC modules import exactly this name.
FILES: create src/indicators/countryRating.mjs and test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs. Do not edit src/ratings/notch.mjs (B1's scope); report defects instead.
B1 CONTRACT YOU USE: notchChange(previous,current) = index(current)-index(previous) on AAA(0)..CCC-(18), positive = downgrade; trims, case-folds, throws RangeError for anything not one of the 19 ratings (non-strings and missing args included). RATING_SCALE exported, frozen.
CONTRACT (only export): countryRatingChangeWl(previous,current) -> 0|1|2. n = notchChange(previous,current); n<=0 -> 0 (upgrade/unchanged, C3); n===1 -> 1; n>=2 -> 2 (REQ-03-12). Exactly two parameters (.length===2), no override argument (C7), no default params, no module state or caching. Rely entirely on notchChange for trimming/case-folding/RangeError; do not duplicate normalisation. Intentional divergence (C6): on a 1-notch downgrade this returns 1 while notchCalculator(...).wl is 0; do not harmonise.
CONSTRAINTS: Node 18+ ESM; no new APIs; no npm deps. The ONLY import is `import { notchChange } from '../ratings/notch.mjs';`. No console.*, process.*, node: imports, fetch(, require( in src/. Pure, synchronous. No Indicator 13 function, no public-source fetch (C4), no UI/CLI output (C8).
TESTS (TDD): cover AC-3 (countryRating part), AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, AC-11 (countryRating part); exhaustive 361-pair loop vs the threshold rule applied to notchChange; AC-9 imports notchCalculator from ../../src/ratings/notch.mjs; assert error type only. Never use the verbatim REQ-06-02 POC example as expected value.
FINISH: run full `node --test` from the worktree root (must exit 0 and run both test files) and the AC-12 grep over src/.
acceptance: 1. (AC-3) Given previous `"a"` and current `" A- "`, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then it returns `1`.
2. (AC-3) Given case/whitespace variants, when called, then `countryRatingChangeWl("bbb+","bb+") === 2`; `("\tBBB+\n","bbb") === 1`; `("aaa","AAA ") === 0`.
3. (AC-8, C3) Given an unchanged rating or an upgrade, when called, then it returns `0`: `("A","A")`, `("A-","A")`, `("CCC-","AAA")`, `("AA+","AAA")`, `("B","BB-")`.
4. (AC-8, REQ-03-12) Given a 1-notch downgrade, when called, then it returns `1`: `("BBB+","BBB")`, `("BBB-","BB+")`, `("AAA","AA+")`, `("CCC","CCC-")`.
5. (AC-8, REQ-03-12) Given a downgrade of 2+ notches, when called, then it returns `2`: `("BBB+","BBB-")`, `("BBB+","BB+")`, `("AAA","AA")`, `("BB","B-")`, `("AAA","CCC-")`.
6. (AC-8) For all 361 pairs: result `===` (`n ≤ 0 ? 0 : n === 1 ? 1 : 2`) with `n = notchChange(p,c)`; `typeof result === "number"`; `Object.is(result, 0)` whenever 0.
7. (AC-8) Over the 361 pairs: wl 0 = 190, wl 1 = 18, wl 2 = 153.
8. (AC-9, C6) `notchCalculator("BBB+","BBB").wl === 0` and `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB+","BBB") === 1`.
9. (AC-9) Over the 361 pairs the two WLs differ only for notches = 1 (18 pairs: calculator 0, Indicator 12 1) and notches = 2 (17 pairs: calculator 1, Indicator 12 2); equal in the other 326.
10. (AC-10, C7) `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2`.
11. (AC-10, C7) Calls in order `("BBB+","BBB-")`, `("BBB+","BBB")`, `("BBB+","BBB-")`, `("BBB+","BBB")` return `2, 1, 2, 1` (no state, no caching).
12. (AC-10, C7) An extra third argument is ignored: `("BBB+","BBB",2) === 1`, `("BBB+","BBB-",0) === 2`.
13. (Scope) `Object.keys(ns)` of `import * as ns from ".../countryRating.mjs"` deep-equals `["countryRatingChangeWl"]`.
14. (AC-11, C1) Each invalid value from the list below, once as `previous` and once as `current` (partner `"BBB"`), throws `RangeError` (`assert.throws(fn, RangeError)`; message not asserted).
15. (AC-11) `countryRatingChangeWl()` and `countryRatingChangeWl("AAA")` throw `RangeError`.
16. (AC-11) `new String("AAA")`, `Symbol("AAA")`, `Object.create(null)` in either position throw `RangeError`. If this fails, report it as a T-01 defect; do not fix it here.
17. (AC-11) `countryRatingChangeWl("CC","AAA")` and `("AAA","D")` throw `RangeError`; never return 0, null or undefined (errors never swallowed).
18. (AC-12) `grep -rnE "console\.|process\.|from ['\"]node:|fetch\(|require\(" src/` prints nothing.

19. (AC-12) `grep -nE "^\s*import|import\(" src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` prints exactly `import { notchChange } from '../ratings/notch.mjs';`; the same grep on `src/ratings/notch.mjs` prints nothing.
20. (AC-12) `package.json` has no `dependencies`, `devDependencies`, `peerDependencies` or `optionalDependencies`.

21. (AC-12, C8) `node --input-type=module -e "import {countryRatingChangeWl} from './src/indicators/countryRating.mjs'; import {notchCalculator} from './src/ratings/notch.mjs'; countryRatingChangeWl('BBB+','BBB-'); notchCalculator('A','BBB');"` from the repo root: empty stdout/stderr, exit 0.

22. (AC-13) From the job worktree root with T-01 merged, `node --test` exits 0 with `# fail 0`, and its `# tests` total is at least the sum of the totals of the two separate unit-file runs (both ran).

23. (AC-13, C2) `grep -rnE "BBB\+['\"]?\s*,\s*['\"]?BB\+|BBB\+\s*(->|→)\s*BB\+" src test`: every hit expects notches 3 / calculator wl 2 / Indicator 12 wl 2; none expects `notches:2` or calculator `wl:1`.
